[[Petalburg Gym]] }} '''Distracting Dustox''' (Japanese: '''VS ドクケイル''' ''VS {{tt|Dokucale|Dustox}}''), titled '''VS Dustox''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 184th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the fourth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Contest Practice''' (Japanese: '''コンテスト指導''' ''Contest Coaching'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Training for the Contest''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Sapphire}} wakes up and discovers that {{adv|Ruby}} had healed her wounds. She discovers a letter where Ruby explains that he had made her clothes in thanks for saving his life. Initially, she is angered but quickly realizes that in order for Ruby to have made clothes for her, he must have taken her measurements, horrifying her. In [[Oldale Town]], Ruby has trouble deciding what to do with his newly-acquired {{p|Mudkip}}. As he tries to find various categories to enter it in, Ruby accidentally angers a wild {{p|Dustox}}. Back at Ruby's home in [[Littleroot Town]], [[Professor Birch]] and Sapphire explain what happened to [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]]. Ruby's mother calls {{adv|Norman}} at the [[Petalburg Gym]], and he decides to look for his runaway son himself. Back in Oldale Town, Ruby and his Pokémon continue to run away from the angry Dustox. Using the dust on its scales, [[Nana]], [[Kiki]], and [[Rara]] are put to sleep, leaving only Mudkip awake due to it being too slow. The Dustox attacks again, forcing Ruby to hide under a bridge, only to be found by Dustox's radar-like antennae. Using the radar on its own head, Mudkip manages to track the quick Dustox and attacks it with {{type|Water}} moves, soaking its wings and rendering it unable to fly. Worried about his safety, Ruby decides to not return the [[Pokédex]] until his bet with Sapphire ends due to it being useful in finding out information about Pokémon. Ruby asks how Mudkip was able to detect the Dustox and consults the Pokédex. Impressed, Ruby decides to give Mudkip the name [[Mumu]] and officially has it join his team. He goes off to find out where he can obtain a [[Contest Pass]] and sets off to the next town. Back in Littleroot Town, Sapphire puts on the clothes that Ruby made for her, shocking her father due to her normal choice in clothing. Professor Birch quickly realizes that she is going to conquer the Gyms, a suggestion that Sapphire confirms. Birch wishes his daughter good luck as she swings away on a vine with her {{p|Torchic}}, [[Chic]], and {{p|Aron}}, [[Rono]]. The counter of the bet continues at seventy-nine days. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} is attacked by a wild {{p|Dustox}}, which is defeated by his {{p|Mudkip}}, who is given the nickname [[Mumu]]. * Ruby decides to keep the [[Pokédex]]. * {{adv|Norman}} is informed that Ruby ran away and decides to search for his son. * {{adv|Sapphire}} goes on her journey to challenge [[Hoenn]]'s Gyms. * Sapphire is revealed to own an [[Rono|Aron]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Dustox}} * {{p|Aron}} ([[Rono|Sapphire's]]) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Sapphire}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Professor Birch]] * [[Mom (Hoenn)|Ruby's mother]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Poochyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Skitty}} ([[Kiki]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Ralts}} ([[Rara]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Mudkip}} ([[Mumu]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Aron}} ([[Rono]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Torchic}} ([[Chic]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Treecko}} ([[Emerald's Sceptile|Professor Birch's]]) * {{p|Dustox}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 毒粉蝶|VS Dustox}} |cs=Vs.
